test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some pencils are cartoons.

All cartoons are rivers.

All rivers are shadows

**Conclusions:**

(I) All pencils are shadows

(II) All cartoons are shadows

(III) Some shadows are pencils.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Given Statements:

Some pencils are cartoons.

All cartoons are rivers.

All rivers are shadows

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c14cf344bddfbf20e3a4054fc1f539cefb60f1af838a1a0aa0187e47b27795cf.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pencils are shadows - False (Because, some pencils are definitely shadows, but All pencils are shadows can be possible only).

II. All cartoons are shadows - True (Because, All cartoons are rivers and All rivers are shadows, this gives All cartoons are shadows).

III Some shadows are pencils - True (Because, those part of pencil which is cartoons will shadow also).

So, Both conclusions II and III follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
